meta.title: Tsippo explores the world
meta.description: Join Tsippo on an adventure: camera on, red backpack on, all around the world.

hero.birdAlt: Tsippo with a red backpack and camera, sitting on a compass
hero.pigeonAlt: A carrier pigeon flies past with a letter
hero.worldAlt: A colourful world map with Tsippo on a skateboard, bike, boat, bus, tram and scooter

friends.title: A new friend everywhere
friends.intro: Wherever Tsippo lands, he always takes a photo. And usually makes a new friend too! Tap a photo to read his postcard.

london.caption: London
london.text: From the top of the red double-decker I can see all of London. Look, there's Big Ben!
london.alt: Tsippo and a boy on top of a red London double-decker bus

amsterdam.caption: Amsterdam, with Mike
amsterdam.text: At first Mike the cat didn't want to come. But now he thinks cycling along the canals is quite fun!
amsterdam.alt: Tsippo rides a blue bicycle with Mike the cat in the basket

norway.caption: Norway
norway.text: I'm sailing the fjords with a real Viking. What big waves!
norway.alt: Tsippo and a Viking on a ship with a dragon head

vienna.caption: Vienna, with Leopold
vienna.text: Leopold sings the whole ride through Vienna. I just sing along: tra-la-la!
vienna.alt: Tsippo and Leopold singing on the box of a horse-drawn carriage

rome.caption: Rome, with Matteo
rome.text: Helmets on, off we go! I zoom past the Colosseum on Matteo's Vespa.
rome.alt: Tsippo and Matteo wearing helmets on a red Vespa

spain.caption: Spain, with Carmen
spain.text: Carmen is teaching me flamenco. Clap, clap, twirl… oops, my backpack!
spain.alt: Tsippo dances flamenco with Carmen in a red dress

skater.caption: Somewhere on the way
skater.text: Where are we? No idea! But skateboarding with my friend is super fast.
skater.alt: Tsippo and a girl with braids riding a skateboard together

friends.mapAlt: A painted map of Europe with famous buildings such as Big Ben, the Eiffel Tower and the Colosseum
